content.text: 6. REMOVE FLUID COUPLING, FAN, FAN BELT GUIDE AND WATER PUMP PULLEY

items: (a) Remove the four nuts from the fluid coupling flange.
(b) Pull out the fluid coupling with the fan shroud.
(c) Remove the fan belt guide, water pump pulley and fan belts.
(d) Remove the fan from the fluid coupling.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of fluid coupling and fan assembly from engine

content.text: Remove the eight bolts and one nut, and remove the water pump and gasket.

content.description: Diagram showing water pump with eight bolt locations and one nut marked around the perimeter

content.text: 1. INSPECT WATER PUMP BODY AND TIMING BELT CASE
Check the water pump body and timing belt case for cracks and damaged gasket surfaces. Replace if necessary.

content.description: Cutaway view of water pump body and timing belt case showing internal impeller and pump housing

content.text: Check that the water pump bearing operation is not rough or noisy.

content.description: Illustration showing hand checking water pump bearing by rotating the pump shaft

content.text: Check the fluid coupling for damage and silicone oil leakage.

content.description: Illustration showing inspection of fluid coupling with ribbed fan clutch assembly
